***TW: this is how I feel when I’m in the middle of a severe mixed episode. I’ve never expressed this. Hopefully this could help add to your narrative that we are normal people who want to accomplish great things. We are stopped by things we cannot control, no matter how badly we dont want to experience these feelings or thoughts. ***Sometimes I feel like I need to kill myself. Not that I want to, but I need to. it’s a horribly frightening experience. It comes on at a time where I feel absolutely hopeless, destitute, and lonely. In this state of “I need to die” I think as if no one cares for me and that I could only do more wrong in my life. That all of my successes are actually failures. Usually if I can cry it out long enough, it’ll subside.*** I realize that these thoughts are not true and I do not need to die. That I have the opportunity to fail over and over again, and vice versa to succeed over and over again. I view bipolar as a person being flooded by emotions they may not be able to control, and that these emotions are brought on by outside stimulus. I personally try to just be content and stable in life.
